name: cidtiee-portal
description: Portal público del CIDTIEE — UTN Facultad Regional Córdoba

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @cidtiee/backend" "npm run dev -w @cidtiee/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @cidtiee/backend && npm run build -w @cidtiee/frontend
scripts.validate: npm run etl && npm run content && npm run build && npm run smoke
